name: Plymouth Navy Strength 57%
production: Same seven botanicals as Plymouth Original, bottled at 57%
Distilled in a single Victorian-era copper pot (Plymouth brand-wide)
history: 1793 | Gin production begins at Black Friars Distillery
1993 | Navy Strength launched for the distillery's 200th anniversary
2008 | Pernod Ricard acquires Plymouth Gin via V&S Group
finish: Balanced by green cardamom and sweet orange
serve_official: Big drinks such as a Negroni
notes: Brand story: high proof needed because gin was stored next to gunpowder below deck. Botanical list and history from owner page (The Absolut Group).
